Definition: of Hebrew origin (H1551); Galilæa (i.e. the heathen circle), a region of Palestine:--Galilee.
BiblicalUsage: Galilee is the northern region where Jesus grew up and did most of His ministry. Matthew calls it Galilee of the Gentiles in Matthew 4:15, quoting the prophet, and Luke says the angel Gabriel was sent to a city of Galilee named Nazareth in Luke 1:26. The region the prophets called the land of darkness became the land where the great light shone.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God chose a despised region for His Son's home. Galilee of the Gentiles was far from Jerusalem's glory, yet the light dawned there first; I hold that God still begins His greatest works in the places men overlook.
